create_graph: create a gtn Graph object to build a finite-state transducer with initial and final nodes
add_node: add a node to a gtn Graph with optional initial and final state flags
add_arc: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with input and output symbol mappings
union_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph
